text.tspan: Dietary land use vs. GDP per capita2013
The share of global habitable land which would be required for agriculture if everyone in the world adopted the
average diet of a given country versus GDP per capita. We currently use approximately 50% of habitable land
for agriculture, as shown by the horizontal line.
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Share of habitable land needed for agriculture
Data source: Alexander et al. (2016); Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026)
Note: GDP per capita is measured in international-$ at 2021 prices to account for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
Where data for 2013 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2008 and 2018 is shown instead.
